opinions.text: Ct. App. Cal., 5th App. Dist. Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari granted limited to question whether the conduct of the police lineup resulted in a violation of petitioner’s constitutional rights. Case transferred to appellate docket.
